1335 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
08-13-1335 minus 131 days:  
Back up 13 days to Aug 1 → 31 days in July → 30 in June → 31 in May → 30 in April → that’s 13+31+30+31+30 = 135 days back from Aug 13 reaches April 1.  
We need 131 days, so 4 days less back than April 1 → April 5.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1335-04-05
